user_text: Perfect, that's done. Wow, it's really late.
text:
It is late! You've covered a huge amount of ground in one session: the full ISO 27001 project plan, SoA and P1 actions with named owners, risk assessment quizzes, a BIA for payroll with a manual pay incident packet, a tabletop exercise kit with printable pages, and two production-ready failover runbooks with cloud CLI commands and validation snippets.

When you pick this up next, the immediate priorities are printing the tabletop kit and scheduling the session, pasting the three ISO CSVs into your tracker and confirming owners with named individuals, and testing the runbook commands in a non-production account before relying on them.

Get some rest. I'll be here when you're ready to continue.
